text: China's state-assets regulator SASAC inaugurated China Changan Automobile Group Co., Ltd. as a central state-owned enterprise on 29 July 2025; Changan is listed as No. 73 in the central SOE directory, under SASAC supervision.
short: Changan is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise under SASAC supervision (No. 73 in the central SOE directory).

source.name: SASAC (en.sasac.gov.cn): China Inaugurates Changan as Central SOE
source.quote: The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC) announced on July 29 the inauguration of China Changan Automobile Group Co., Ltd. （Changan） as a central state-owned enterprise (SOE).

additionalSources.name: Xinhua (english.news.cn): China inaugurates Changan Auto as central SOE
additionalSources.quote: China's state-owned assets regulator on Tuesday announced the inauguration of China Changan Automobile Group Co., Ltd. as a centrally administered state-owned enterprise (SOE).
